name: anxin-care-web
description: 新山老人照顾协调服务 — 网站 + 三端 Web/Android 应用

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && ls -la app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../../downloads && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../downloads/anxin-care.apk && ls -la ../../downloads/
